task.title: Building a website
task.shortdesc: Build a site from any DITA map or bookmap with one command, then open the generated home page.

prereq.p: The plugin is installed (see ) and you have a DITA map to publish.

stepxmp.p: For example, this manual is built with:

stepresult.p: The home page shows the publication title, the abstract and attribution when the map is a bookmap, and a contents tree. Every topic page carries the sidebar navigation.

step.cmd: Publish the output directory to any static host.

info.p: The site is self-contained: no content-delivery networks, no fonts fetched from elsewhere, no cookies, and no server-side code. Links are relative, so the site works from a sub-path as well as a domain root.

result.note: The output directory is created if missing and overwritten in place — point it somewhere disposable, not at your source.

postreq.p: project filesDITA-OTproject filesTo build several publications in one command, describe them in a DITA-OT project file, one deliverable each, with transtype="govuk" and the parameters as param elements:

Each deliverable is a separate build into its own folder under the output folder. They share nothing, so links from one to another do not resolve. A plain href to a topic of another deliverable copies that topic into this one. scope="peer" leaves an unchecked relative path. DITA's cross-deliverable keys are not supported by DITA-OT 4.4. For publications that link to each other, build them as one site from one map instead.
